parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this PCP Server.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the PCP Server. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Method used to assign {{param|ServerNameOrAddress}} and create this table entry. {{enum}} Note: In the {{enum|DHCPv4}} and {{enum|DHCPv6}} cases, if more than one IP address is received {{param|ServerNameOrAddress}} will be the first address and {{param|AdditionalServerAddresses}} will be the remaining addresses.

parameters.name: ServerNameOrAddress
parameters.description: The FQDN or IP address of the PCP Server, assigned as described under {{param|Origin}}.

parameters.name: ServerAddressInUse
parameters.description: The IP address currently in use for the PCP Server, derived from the value of {{param|ServerNameOrAddress}}. {{empty}} indicates that no PCP Server address is currently known.

parameters.name: AdditionalServerAddresses
parameters.description: PCP Server addresses in addition to {{param|ServerNameOrAddress}}. This can be non-empty only if {{param|Origin}} is {{enum|DHCPv4|Origin}} or {{enum|DHCPv6|Origin}} and if more than one PCP Server address was received.

parameters.name: ExternalIPAddress
parameters.description: The external IP address of the PCP-controlled device hosting this server.

parameters.name: CurrentVersion
parameters.description: This is the version of PCP resulting from client-server Version Negotiation. This parameter is based on Version from {{bibref|RFC6887}}.

parameters.name: MaximumFilters
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of inbound filters allowed to be associated with a mapping entry on this server.

parameters.name: PortQuota
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum number of ports allocated to this PCP Client on this server. A value of 0 means that there is no limitation.

parameters.name: PreferredLifetime
parameters.description: Indicates the preferred lifetime (in {{units}}) to be used for mappings with this server when no preference is selected by an application/user.

parameters.name: Capabilities
parameters.description: Indicates the capabilities supported by the PCP Server. {{enum}}

object.description: This table contains the PCP Servers to be used by the PCP Client. Entries are either statically configured or automatically created via DHCP options OPTION_V4_PCP_SERVER and OPTION_V6_PCP_SERVER, as per {{bibref|RFC7291}}. Each OPTION_V4_PCP_SERVER or OPTION_V6_PCP_SERVER option corresponds to a {{object}} instance. If an option returns multiple addresses then that {{object}} instance has multiple addresses.
